name: muse2api bridge (Codespaces)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends chromium fonts-wqy-zenhei fonts-freefont-ttf procps curl && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
postStartCommand: setsid nohup .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn cors_app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 18610 > /tmp/bridge.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & bash ~/start-bridges.sh || true
